conditions: Should be in the context of using RequestConfiguration object.
The tags to enable the Child-directed setting and setTagForUnderAgeOfConsent() should not both simultaneously be set to true. If they are, the child-directed setting takes precedence.
effects: When using this tag, you are telling Google to treat your ad requests as if they are meant for users in the European Economic Area (EEA) who are under the age of consent.
Tagging enables compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Prevents personalized advertising, remarketing, requests to third-party vendors such as ad measurement pixels and third-party ad servers, and the transmission of Android advertising identifier (AAID) when set to TAG_FOR_UNDER_AGE_OF_CONSENT_TRUE.
Included in all future ad requests for the remainder of the session.

conditions: This tag is to indicate you want the ad request to receive treatment for users in the European Economic Area (EEA) under the age of consent.
effects: This prevents the transmission of the Android advertising identifier (AAID).

conditions: Tagging with RequestConfiguration.TAG_FOR_UNDER_AGE_OF_CONSENT_FALSE indicates that you want the ad request to NOT receive treatment for users in the European Economic Area (EEA) under the age of consent.
Use this tag to indicate that you have not specified whether the ad request should receive treatment for users in the European Economic Area (EEA) under the age of consent.
